import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestCreateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	Init()
	g, err := createGrocery("apple", 10)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	defer deleteGrocery(g.ID)

	assert.Equal(t, "apple", g.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 10, g.Quantity)
}

func TestUpdateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	Init()
	g, err := createGrocery("apple", 10)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	defer deleteGrocery(g.ID)

		g, err = updateGrocery(g.ID, "banana", 20)
		assert.NoError(t, err)

		defer deleteGrocery(g.ID)

		g = *getGrocery(g.ID)
		assert.Equal(t, "banana", g.Name)
		assert.Equal(t, 20, g.Quantity)
}

func TestDeleteGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	Init()
	g, err := createGrocery("apple", 10)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

		defer deleteGrocery(g.ID)

	g = *getGrocery(g.ID)
	assert.Nil(t, g)
}

func TestListGroceries(t *testing.T) {
	Init()
	createGrocery("apple", 10)
	createGrocery("banana", 20)

	gs, err := listGroceries()
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Len(t, gs, 2)

	 for _, g := range gs {
			if g.Name == "apple" && (g.Quantity == 10 || g.Quantity == 20) {
				break
			}
	}

	g = *getGrocery(1)
	assert.NotNil(t, g)
}
